column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# 5.0 GB reservation: 1.5 GB alias region, 256 MB stack, 3.0 GB heap region (for 2.0 GB arena and 830 MB memory pools)
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, unless the engine says otherwise) ----
# main holds 396 GLSLC outputs and the RomFS has no BNSH / BAHS / UnityFS: the shaders are compiled into main (13 Sentinels, the KTGL games)
# with shader_main_glslc: single-stage programs combined per draw (every GLSLC output in main seen so far is one stage)
# bf3.arh entries holding SPCH shader packs: all of them. Besides the 5 global /monolib/shader/*.wishp packs and the 23 /map/*.wismda (which embed their terrain and prop shaders;
# the title map ma24a held the 41 shaders the first run missed), the stored /chr/**/*.wismt model streams carry packs inside inner xbc1 blocks (219 of the 354 shaders the first field missed)
# bf3.arh entries whose GLSLC compiler outputs are shaders: /effect/cmn_assets.wipac (1,362 outputs; 90 of the shaders the first field missed)
# shaders no container holds: 35 load-time patches of cmn_assets.wipac's GLSLC outputs and 20 others, dumped by the host on the phone (DM_NVN_SHDUMP) and copied to <version dir>/shader_dump
# 79 of the 91 geometry shaders turn points into quads (4-vertex strips, mostly effects): drawn without the stage they give points of undefined size, so their draws are skipped
